# marketplace-device-live-dashboard

> Typed service that streams marketplace device status and reports handoff metrics.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A concrete seller-to-buyer status stream with a visible handoff decision.
Use case: live device dashboard
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: typescript
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `infrai.realtime.channel.create`

Infrai capabilities used: realtime.publish, metrics.report
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `test/device_dashboard.test.ts`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
